verdict.rationale: Neon is documented as an open-source serverless Postgres platform that separates storage from compute. It works with standard Postgres clients like psql and DBeaver, and it ships documented Postgres extensions such as pgvector. A self-hosting user notes it lets them keep Postgres as their database. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the supported extension catalog and Postgres versions, a documented list of any compatibility differences from upstream Postgres, and independent hands-on confirmation that existing Postgres code runs unchanged.
